description: Shared HEX slash-command catalog. Single source of truth for help, completion, and dispatch availability across the Python console, Rust TUI, and ACP surfaces. Status values: supported | unavailable.

commands.name: /help
commands.description: Show available slash commands for this surface

commands.name: /mode
commands.description: Switch execution mode: plan (read-only spec), agent (autonomous), code (direct synthesis)

commands.name: /plan
commands.description: Switch to read-only architecture planning mode

commands.name: /agent
commands.description: Switch to autonomous agent execution mode

commands.name: /code
commands.description: Switch to direct code synthesis mode

commands.name: /rename
commands.description: Rename the agent persona identity

commands.name: /status
commands.description: Session, workspace, and last task status

commands.name: /diff
commands.description: Inspect uncommitted workspace changes (TUI toggles the diff pane)

commands.name: /tool-result
commands.description: Read a page of the latest or selected tool's full stored result

commands.name: /history
commands.description: Browse older native transcript archive pages

commands.name: /transcript
commands.description: Read exact archived transcript content in byte-offset pages

commands.name: /session-history
commands.description: Browse durable conversation turns without loading the whole session

commands.name: /history-turn
commands.description: Read the complete prompt or response of a durable turn

commands.name: /sbs
commands.description: Side-by-side diff for one file (TUI toggles the diff viewer mode)

commands.name: /rollback
commands.description: Cancel a task and roll back the uncommitted CoW workspace layer

commands.name: /fork
commands.description: Fork a task into speculative attempt branches

commands.name: /skills
commands.description: List registered skills, risk scores, and gate decisions

commands.name: /tools
commands.description: Display the categorized tool catalog

commands.name: /learn
commands.description: Synthesize and verify a reusable SKILL.md bundle

commands.name: /scan
commands.description: Scan and register a SKILL.md bundle via SkillSpector

commands.name: /model
commands.description: Inspect or switch the active model

commands.name: /reasoning
commands.description: Inspect or switch reasoning effort level

commands.name: /compressor
commands.description: Inspect or switch the verbose log compressor mode (failure-digest compression; not the live context window)

commands.name: /compress
commands.description: Compact the local session transcript buffer (display/rewind history; the live model context is compacted automatically by the agent loop)

commands.name: /budget
commands.description: Provider budget and token telemetry

commands.name: /quota
commands.description: Antigravity credential status and live model quota windows

commands.name: /blast
commands.description: Active Graphify AST blast-radius analysis

commands.name: /proof
commands.description: Proof-Carrying Artifact bundle and event-chain verification

commands.name: /memory
commands.description: Search governed project memories with staleness badges

commands.name: /remember
commands.description: Record a governed project memory

commands.name: /reflect
commands.description: Graphify deterministic work-memory reflection (LESSONS.md)

commands.name: /search
commands.description: SQLite FTS5 BM25 search across the task journal

commands.name: /doctor
commands.description: System health diagnostics and self-healing

commands.name: /recipe
commands.description: Auto-detect project bootstrap, build, test, and start recipes

commands.name: /lsp
commands.description: Language server status and compiler diagnostics

commands.name: /backup
commands.description: Quick zip backup of state, config, and ledger

commands.name: /dump
commands.description: Plain-text diagnostic dump with secret redaction

commands.name: /workers
commands.description: Registered distributed workers, CoW backends, and heartbeats

commands.name: /subagents
commands.description: Inspect active and completed subagents and the delegation tree

commands.name: /ps
commands.description: List and manage PTY background processes

commands.name: /kernel
commands.description: Inspect or drive the REPL code kernel

commands.name: /react
commands.description: Toggle the continuous multi-turn autonomous ReAct loop

commands.name: /rewind
commands.description: Rewind conversation history with ledger branching

commands.name: /lease
commands.description: Manage temporal auto-approval leases for trusted commands

commands.name: /harness2
commands.description: Gated Harness-squared Propose-Probe-Compose probe

commands.name: /skin
commands.description: Switch console theme (amber, cyberpunk, matrix, nord, mono)

commands.name: /voice
commands.description: Toggle hands-free voice mode

commands.name: /project
commands.description: Inspect the active project card or switch workspace context

commands.name: /banner
commands.description: Re-render the startup splash screen

commands.name: /gc
commands.description: Run storage retention garbage collection

commands.name: /clear
commands.description: Clear the dialogue viewport or terminal screen

commands.name: /quit
commands.description: Exit the interactive session
